# Tool reference

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen_tool_reference.py — do not edit by hand. -->

All 18 tools, generated from the live registry.
The complete schema set costs approximately **3,353 tokens** and is
re-read by the model on every turn.

Every tool returns `ToolResult(text, data, image_png)`: `text` is for the model,
`data` is structured for programs, and `image_png` carries a screenshot when the
tool captured one.

## Screenshot

*observe* · risk **low**

Capture the screen as an image. Use this to see the current state of the desktop before acting. Returns cursor position and the active window.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `display` | `integer` |  | Monitor index; omit for the whole virtual desktop |
| `region` | `array<integer>` |  | Optional [x, y, width, height] to capture only part of the screen |

<details><summary>JSON schema</summary>

```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "display": {
      "type": "integer",
      "description": "Monitor index; omit for the whole virtual desktop"
    },
    "region": {
      "type": "array",
      "description": "Optional [x, y, width, height] to capture only part of the screen",
      "items": {
        "type": "integer"
      }
    }
  }
}
```

</details>

## Snapshot

*observe* · risk **low**

Inspect the desktop: active window, open windows, and optionally the interactive elements inside the foreground window. Element ids can be passed to Click/Type/Scroll as `label` to target controls semantically instead of by coordinates. Enable `elements` only when you need to locate a control, since the list is long.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `elements` | `boolean` |  | Include the interactive element tree of the active window |
| `all_windows` | `boolean` |  | List every open window, not just the active one |
| `image` | `boolean` |  | Also return a screenshot (default true) |

<details><summary>JSON schema</summary>

```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "elements": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "description": "Include the interactive element tree of the active window"
    },
    "all_windows": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "description": "List every open window, not just the active one"
    },
    "image": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "description": "Also return a screenshot (default true)"
    }
  }
}
```

</details>

## DisplayInventory

*observe* · risk **low**

List displays with bounds, work area, DPI and scale factor. Use this to convert between screenshot pixels and screen coordinates on multi-monitor or high-DPI setups.

Takes no parameters.

<details><summary>JSON schema</summary>

```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {}
}
```

</details>

## Click

*input* · risk **high**

Click the mouse. Target by `label` (preferred) or `loc`; with neither, clicks at the current cursor position. clicks=2 is a double click, clicks=0 only hovers.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `loc` | `array<integer>` |  | Screen coordinates [x, y]. Prefer `label` when the target is a named control. |
| `label` | `string` |  | Element id or text/class fragment of the target control, e.g. "3" or "Save". Resolved against the active window first, then all windows. |
| `button` | `string` |  | left (default), right, or middle |
| `clicks` | `integer` |  | Number of clicks; 0 hovers, 2 double-clicks |

<details><summary>JSON schema</summary>

```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "loc": {
      "type": "array",
      "description": "Screen coordinates [x, y]. Prefer `label` when the target is a named control.",
      "items": {
        "type": "integer"
      }
    },
    "label": {
      "type": "string",
      "description": "Element id or text/class fragment of the target control, e.g. \"3\" or \"Save\". Resolved against the active window first, then all windows."
    },
    "button": {
      "type": "string",
      "description": "left (default), right, or middle"
    },
    "clicks": {
      "type": "integer",
      "description": "Number of clicks; 0 hovers, 2 double-clicks"
    }
  }
}
```

</details>

## Type

*input* · risk **high**

Type text into the focused control. Unicode is injected directly, so non-ASCII text works. Set clear=true to select-all and replace first. If the target is not focused, pass `label` or `loc` to click it first.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `text` | `string` | yes | Text to type |
| `loc` | `array<integer>` |  | Screen coordinates [x, y]. Prefer `label` when the target is a named control. |
| `label` | `string` |  | Element id or text/class fragment of the target control, e.g. "3" or "Save". Resolved against the active window first, then all windows. |
| `clear` | `boolean` |  | Select all and replace before typing |
| `press_enter` | `boolean` |  | Press Enter after typing |
| `caret` | `string` |  | start, end, or idle (default) |

```json

  "type": "object",
  "properties": {

      "description": "Text to type"
    },
    "loc": {
      "type": "array",
      "description": "Screen coordinates [x, y]. Prefer `label` when the target is a named control.",
      "items": {
        "type": "integer"
      }
    },
    "label": {
      "type": "string",
      "description": "Element id or text/class fragment of the target control, e.g. \"3\" or \"Save\". Resolved against the active window first, then all windows."
    },
    "clear": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "description": "Select all and replace before typing"
    },
    "press_enter": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "description": "Press Enter after typing"
    },
    "caret": {
      "type": "string",
      "description": "start, end, or idle (default)"

  "required": [
```

## MultiSelect

*input* · risk **high**

|---|---|---|---|
| `locs` | `array<array>` |  | List of [x, y] pairs |
| `labels` | `array<string>` |  | List of element labels/ids |
| `press_ctrl` | `boolean` |  | Hold Ctrl between clicks for multi-select |

```json
  "properties": {

      "type": "array",
```

## App

*system* · risk **high**

Launch an application, or manage windows. mode=launch starts a program by name ('notepad') or full path. mode=switch focuses a window by title. mode=minimize/maximize/restore change window state.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `mode` | `string` |  | launch (default), switch, minimize, maximize, restore, close |
| `name` | `string` |  | Program name/path to launch, or window title |
| `args` | `array<string>` |  | Arguments for launch |
| `wait` | `number` |  | Seconds to wait for the window to appear after launch |

<details><summary>JSON schema</summary>

```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "mode": {
      "type": "string",
      "description": "launch (default), switch, minimize, maximize, restore, close"
    },
    "name": {
      "type": "string",
      "description": "Program name/path to launch, or window title"
    },
    "args": {
      "type": "array",
      "description": "Arguments for launch",
      "items": {
        "type": "string"
      }
    },
    "wait": {
      "type": "number",
      "description": "Seconds to wait for the window to appear after launch"
    }
  }
}
```

</details>

## Process

*system* · risk **high**

List running processes or terminate one. mode=list shows pid, name and thread count; filter by `name`. mode=kill terminates by pid (or by name when pid is omitted).

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `mode` | `string` | yes | list (default) or kill |
| `name` | `string` |  | Filter by process name substring, or target for kill |
| `pid` | `integer` |  | Process id (required for a precise kill) |
| `limit` | `integer` |  | Max rows for list, default 60 |

<details><summary>JSON schema</summary>

```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "mode": {
      "type": "string",
      "description": "list (default) or kill"
    },
    "name": {
      "type": "string",
      "description": "Filter by process name substring, or target for kill"
    },
    "pid": {
      "type": "integer",
      "description": "Process id (required for a precise kill)"
    },
    "limit": {
      "type": "integer",
      "description": "Max rows for list, default 60"
    }
  },
  "required": [
    "mode"
  ]
}
```

</details>

## Clipboard

*system* · risk **high**

Read or write the clipboard. mode=get returns the current text; mode=set replaces it with `text`; mode=clear empties it. Useful for moving large blocks of text without typing them out.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `mode` | `string` | yes | get, set, or clear |
| `text` | `string` |  | Text to put on the clipboard (mode=set) |

<details><summary>JSON schema</summary>

```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "mode": {
      "type": "string",
      "description": "get, set, or clear"
    },
    "text": {
      "type": "string",
      "description": "Text to put on the clipboard (mode=set)"
    }
  },
  "required": [
    "mode"
  ]
}
```

</details>

## Wait

*system* · risk **low**

Pause for a fixed number of seconds. Prefer WaitFor when you know what you are waiting for — a fixed sleep is either too short (click lands on a half-drawn window) or too long (wasted time).

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `seconds` | `number` | yes | Seconds to pause, max 30 |

<details><summary>JSON schema</summary>

```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "seconds": {
      "type": "number",
      "description": "Seconds to pause, max 30"
    }
  },
  "required": [
    "seconds"
  ]
}
```

</details>

## WaitFor

*system* · risk **low**

Wait until a condition becomes true, polling internally. Far more reliable than Wait. Conditions: window (a window whose title contains `text` exists), gone (that window disappeared), element (a control matching `text` exists in the active window), title (the active window title contains `text`), change (the screen differs from now).

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `condition` | `string` | yes | window, gone, element, title, or change |
| `text` | `string` |  | Text to match (window title or element label) |
| `timeout` | `number` |  | Max seconds to wait, default 10 |
| `interval` | `number` |  | Poll interval in seconds, default 0.3 |

<details><summary>JSON schema</summary>

```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "condition": {
      "type": "string",
      "description": "window, gone, element, title, or change"
    },
    "text": {
      "type": "string",
      "description": "Text to match (window title or element label)"
    },
    "timeout": {
      "type": "number",
      "description": "Max seconds to wait, default 10"
    },
    "interval": {
      "type": "number",
      "description": "Poll interval in seconds, default 0.3"
    }
  },
  "required": [
    "condition"
  ]
}
```

</details>

## FileSystem

*files* · risk **high**

File operations. mode=read returns text content (use offset/limit for big files); write creates or overwrites; append adds to the end; list shows a directory; mkdir creates directories; delete removes (directories need recursive=true); move renames or relocates; copy duplicates; exists checks; search finds files by glob pattern.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `mode` | `string` | yes | read, write, append, list, mkdir, delete, move, copy, exists, search |
| `path` | `string` | yes | Target path (absolute recommended) |
| `destination` | `string` |  | Target for move/copy |
| `content` | `string` |  | Content for write/append |
| `pattern` | `string` |  | Glob for search, e.g. *.log |
| `recursive` | `boolean` |  | Required for deleting a non-empty directory |
| `overwrite` | `boolean` |  | Allow write to replace an existing file |
| `offset` | `integer` |  | First line to read (0-based) |
| `limit` | `integer` |  | Max lines to read |
| `encoding` | `string` |  | Text encoding, default utf-8 |

<details><summary>JSON schema</summary>

```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "mode": {
      "type": "string",
      "description": "read, write, append, list, mkdir, delete, move, copy, exists, search"
    },
    "path": {
      "type": "string",
      "description": "Target path (absolute recommended)"
    },
    "destination": {
      "type": "string",
      "description": "Target for move/copy"
    },
    "content": {
      "type": "string",
      "description": "Content for write/append"
    },
    "pattern": {
      "type": "string",
      "description": "Glob for search, e.g. *.log"
    },
    "recursive": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "description": "Required for deleting a non-empty directory"
    },
    "overwrite": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "description": "Allow write to replace an existing file"
    },
    "offset": {
      "type": "integer",
      "description": "First line to read (0-based)"
    },
    "limit": {
      "type": "integer",
      "description": "Max lines to read"
    },
    "encoding": {
      "type": "string",
      "description": "Text encoding, default utf-8"
    }
  },
  "required": [

}
```

## Scrape

*web* · risk **low**

Fetch a web page and return its readable text. Use `query` to only return lines mentioning a term. This does not run JavaScript, so client-rendered pages may come back mostly empty.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `url` | `string` | yes | Page URL (http/https) |
| `query` | `string` |  | Optional: only keep lines containing this text |
| `limit` | `integer` |  | Max characters to return, default 20000 |

<details><summary>JSON schema</summary>

```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "url": {
      "type": "string",
      "description": "Page URL (http/https)"
    },
    "query": {
      "type": "string",
      "description": "Optional: only keep lines containing this text"
    },
    "limit": {
      "type": "integer",
      "description": "Max characters to return, default 20000"
    }
  },
  "required": [
    "url"
  ]
}
```

</details>
